findings.message: Dresher does not establish that the defendants in the present case had an opportunity to present defenses or respond to a motion for partial summary judgment.

details.claim:
Dresher v. Burt, 75 Ohio St.3d 280, 293, 662 N.E.2d 264 (1996).
Defendants have had opportunity to present their defenses and reply to plaintiffs Motion for Partial Summary Judgment.
details.problem: Dresher does not establish that the defendants in the present case had an opportunity to present defenses or respond to a motion for partial summary judgment.
details.reason: The evidence establishes that Dresher v. Burt, 75 Ohio St.3d 280, 662 N.E.2d 264 (1996) does not address the procedural posture or outcome regarding the opportunity of defendants to present defenses or respond to a motion for partial summary judgment. The decision solely concerns the standards for granting summary judgment under Civ.R. 56, as evidenced by the quote: 'The sole issue in this appeal involves the standards for granting summary judgment when the moving party asserts that the nonmoving party has no evidence to establish an essential element of the nonmoving party’s case.'
